transcript.message: Hello, this is calling from our company. Is this a good time to talk about your account?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.message: Um, hi... uh, not really? I mean, I'm at work right now, kind of busy. Can you maybe call me later? I'll try to figure things out, I promise.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message:
Hi, this is Sarah from ClearPath Financial Solutions—thanks so much for picking up, and I completely understand. You're at work, and this isn’t the best time. I appreciate you letting me know.

Absolutely, I can call you back—your time matters, and I want to make sure we talk when you can focus and feel comfortable. Would later today, maybe around 6:30 or 7 PM, be better? Or is there another time that works for you?

And hey—I hear you saying you’ll try to figure things out, and I truly respect that. Whatever’s going on, I’m here to help, not to add stress. When we do connect, we’ll just talk through your situation and see what kind of plan could work for you. No pressure, no surprises—just options.

What time would be best for a quick, private chat?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.message: Oh, um... 6:30 might be okay, I think? I should be home by then. But sometimes I have dinner with my sister, so—maybe 7? I'll check and see. Honestly, I just need a minute to look at my schedule... I'll try to make it work. Just... can we keep it quick?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message:
Of course—7 PM works perfectly, and I’ll make sure we keep it brief and focused so it doesn’t take up your evening. I totally get that you’ve got other things going on, and family time is important.  

So I’ll plan to call you this evening at 7, and if anything comes up, just let me know—I’m happy to adjust. When we talk, I’ll just share a couple of clear options based on your situation, we’ll see what fits, and from there, you can decide what feels right. No pressure, no long conversations—promise.  

Thanks again for being upfront with me. I know this isn’t easy, and I really appreciate you being willing to connect. I’ll talk to you at 7, Sarah. Take care until then.
